name: veteran-engineering-studio
description: End-to-end software engineering plus specialist frontend product design and Python Agent engineering in one plugin: repository takeover, architecture, debugging, backend/data, tool-using agents, explicit state/loop contracts, release/operations, high-fidelity UI/UX, design-system reuse, responsive implementation, accessibility, and rendered visual QA.

interface.shortDescription: Full-stack engineering with advanced Figma product design and visual QA
interface.longDescription: A two-skill engineering plugin with one accountable delivery path. Veteran Full-Stack Engineer owns substantial software work end to end across architecture, frontend integration, backend, data, Python Agent systems, debugging, migrations, release and operations. Frontend Design Builder owns material UI/UX design, design systems, design-to-code, responsive interaction, motion, accessibility and rendered visual fidelity, then returns evidence and deviations to the full-stack owner.
defaultPrompt: Take ownership of this software task end to end, using the frontend design specialist whenever visual UI quality or design-system work is material.
Audit this product across engineering and UI quality, implement the highest-value fixes, and verify the real runtime result.
Build this feature as a production-quality vertical slice, including polished frontend behavior and rendered QA when applicable.
